title: Validation report for cdif.bbr.metadata.provProperties.provActivity - PROV-O Provenance Activity

entries.message: Test was expected to fail and it did.

ValidationError: 42 is not of type 'array'

Failed validating 'type' in schema['allOf'][0]['properties']['prov:used']:
    {'type': 'array',
     'description': 'Entities the activity used. Optional. Each item is a '
                    'string (an IRI or a free-text name) or an object that '
                    'identifies the entity by @id. The @id reference is '
                    'deliberately NOT sealed: an extending profile may '
                    'describe the entity in place as long as it keeps the '
                    '@id, and a profile that wants only bare references '
                    'can seal it itself. Role-keyed wrappers (an object '
                    'whose key names a role, with no @id) are not '
                    'accepted; in the schema.org implementation what an '
                    'activity used is recorded with schema:instrument and '
                    'schema:object instead.',
     'items': {'anyOf': [{'type': 'string',
                          'description': 'an IRI or a free-text name of '
                                         'the entity used'},
                         {'type': 'object',
                          'description': 'an entity used, identified by '
                                         '@id; it may also be described in '
                                         'place',
                          'required': ['@id'],
                          'properties': {'@id': {'type': 'string'}}}]},
     'x-jsonld-id': 'http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#used'}

On instance['prov:used']:
    42
